title: MEDC Community Development Disaster Recovery
overview: The Michigan Economic Development Corporation (MEDC) is accepting applications for the Community Development Block Grant Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) Program to recover from Michigan's 2024 Severe Storms, Tornadoes, and Flooding. The goal is to address unmet recovery and mitigation needs associated with general infrastructure, public facilities, and hazard mitigation planning. Eligible applicants are units of general local governments in Eaton, Ingham, Macomb, Monroe, and Oakland counties. Eligible projects include designing and constructing infrastructure and public facilities (PIPF program) and creating/updating plans, codes, and ordinances to minimize future risks (Planning program). At least 80% of funds must be expended in HUD Most Impacted and Distressed (MID) areas (Oakland, Macomb, Monroe counties), and at least 70% must benefit low- and moderate-income persons. The PIPF program uses competitive rounds with applications due May 4, 2026, while the Planning program uses a first-come, first-served process. Show More
